items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: He was all right. The only time we had a little misunderstanding was the time that the guy gave me a tip to play a certain number for him... I walked off the job.

ctx.x: Oh, she was playing piano with him. I know Walter Pichon was playing with him a while. That kind of thing was playing piano with him. The Draft team you're talking about? No, this was a big band.
No, I'm talking about Big I. Lou Nelson. Oh, Big I. Lou.
I'm talking about Lloyd. See there's two Nelsons, John. Yeah, yeah, yeah. No, I'm talking about that. Oh, that was a small band, Four Pieces. You worked regularly with that band?
